notes.title: Happy Holidays!
notes.notes:
All the sports-men have donned their festive outfits to celebrate the season - but watch out!  Krampus is naturally frustrated by this seasonal merriment and vows to disrupt the festivities.

This event event lasts through the month of December, so go bop some snowmen!
